Create itinerary. What is the trip name? Name your trip, pick the dates you travel, add the places you want to see, invite the people you travel with and save it to your account for later. Every trip keeps its own list of hotels, restaurants, museums, beaches and desert tours, with opening hours, prices, the distance between stops and a map you can share with everyone on the trip. Trips you build here sync to the app on your phone, so the plan you made at home is the plan you follow when you land, with every booking and every note in one place.
